exposure: receipt of guidance about the puerperal period
outcome: complaints and problems during nursing consultations
difficulties in care given to the newborn
cohort: The study included 114 women in the puerperium.
finding: A significant proportion of puerperal women (80.7%) experienced difficulties with newborn or self-care, 42.1% reported breastfeeding difficulties (with 30.7% having fissures), and overall, problems were related to newborn care, breastfeeding, emotional state, and family support.
cross-section timing: during the puerperium at nursing consultations
